python_interfaces.name: TaskRepository
python_interfaces.rule: Task internal identity is immutable UUIDv4; task_kind local|wfm is immutable after creation; repositories never commit internally

python_interfaces.name: WfmTaskRepository
python_interfaces.rule: Task No. is canonical external attempt identity, owning RFC is exactly one current relationship with append-only reassignment history, and source projection is rebuildable from LLD-04 accepted evidence rather than independent source authority

python_interfaces.name: TaskPlanRepository
python_interfaces.rule: plan revisions are immutable; current operational plan can change only by pointing to a newly appended accepted revision; Objective membership pins an exact accepted plan_revision_id and is never silently advanced

python_interfaces.name: TaskExecutionRepository
python_interfaces.rule: actual start/end/termination/correction evidence is append-only; current projection is rebuildable and never inferred from plan/provider completion

python_interfaces.name: TaskOutcomeRepository
python_interfaces.rule: accepted outcomes are completed|incomplete|cancelled_without_execution; Awaiting Review is a derived review state, not a fabricated accepted outcome

python_interfaces.name: TaskRelationshipRepository
python_interfaces.rule: direct SR/RFC links are Local-Task-only; Device Reference links may belong to Local or WFM Tasks; all links preserve relationship history and target LLD-03 identities, never Network Element IDs

python_interfaces.name: TaskRetryRepository
python_interfaces.rule: every retry has exactly one immediate predecessor; one attempt has at most one direct successor; retry identity is never reused

python_interfaces.name: TaskActivityLineageRepository
python_interfaces.rule: reviewed activity lineage supports competing-WFM detection; lack of lineage never authorizes collapsing distinct Task Nos

python_interfaces.name: ObjectiveRepository
python_interfaces.rule: objective_id and MW tracking identity never change; supersession/archive preserve the Objective row and history

python_interfaces.name: ObjectiveMembershipRepository
python_interfaces.rule: one Task has at most one current Objective; current membership pins the exact accepted Task-plan revision reviewed for that Objective; history events preserve prior Objective and plan-revision context

python_interfaces.name: ObjectiveProjectionRepository
python_interfaces.rule: envelope/aggregate rows are transactionally maintained rebuildable projections; overlap search uses indexed strict interval predicate start < candidate_end AND end > candidate_start

python_interfaces.name: GroupingProposalRepository
python_interfaces.rule: proposal membership is persisted row-wise, exact and revision-bound; rejection suppression depends on exact material-input fingerprint rather than unrelated global changes

python_interfaces.name: HistoricalObjectiveProposalRepository
python_interfaces.rule: provider Complete + valid accepted source plan may suggest reviewed historical structure when no conflicting current operational plan exists; an exactly matching operational plan may be reused, otherwise a dedicated historical_source_structure plan may be created only by AcceptHistoricalObjectiveProposal; proposal/import alone never records execution/outcome/Inventory facts

python_interfaces.name: ObjectiveReviewRepository
python_interfaces.rule: review event stores reviewed_at and exact membership/outcome fingerprint plus derived aggregate snapshot; later material correction invalidates currentness without editing the old review

python_interfaces.name: OperationalCountInclusionRepository
python_interfaces.rule: exclusion is reporting projection only and never deletes Task, Objective, source or audit history

python_interfaces.name: ObjectiveTimezoneService
python_interfaces.rule: setting change never mutates persisted task/objective instants; wall-clock preservation requires explicit reviewed Task plan revisions

python_interfaces.name: WfmImportReader
python_interfaces.rule: matches LLD-04 exactly; base token covers immutable identity/current RFC assignment/current source projection/current plan/membership/lock revisions relevant to the accepted proposal

python_interfaces.name: WfmImportMutationService
python_interfaces.contract: caller supplies one outer LLD-04 UnitOfWork/command receipt. Exact Task No. adopts the existing WFM in place; source projection update changes no execution/outcome/membership authority; reviewed operational-plan adoption appends a Task plan revision but never silently updates Objective membership. Any membership-plan mismatch becomes regroup-review input.

python_interfaces.name: RfcTerminalTaskParticipant
python_interfaces.contract: snapshot/capture share one WFM eligibility predicate/order. preview owns the complete TASKS_OBJECTIVES count/fingerprint. hard-delete classify is read-only and uses one exact predicate for stable snapshot and current writer read contexts. revalidate recomputes terminal impact read-only in the caller LLD-03 UoW and exact-compares reviewed values. terminal apply runs there only after both provider revalidations are READY, deliberate proof is consumed and the outer receipt exists; it receives bounded command provenance, preserves provider source/SRs/unrelated Local Tasks, commits nothing independently and returns only the fixed-shape participant apply summary while exact result/history rows remain LLD-05-owned.

python_interfaces.name: RfcHistoryRiskProvider
python_interfaces.rule: HIGH when any owned/related Task has accepted plan, Objective membership, execution, retry, outcome, source-adoption or protected Task history; INDETERMINATE fails closed

python_interfaces.name: InventoryTaskDependencyProvider
python_interfaces.rule: exactly matches LLD-07 InventoryTaskDependencyProvider; LLD-05 never rewrites Inventory-owned reservation/spare-use/physical-unit history; accepted allocation/physical-consequence/protected Inventory history blocks Task hard delete, and retry cloning copies only explicitly selected currently eligible planning relationships

python_interfaces.name: TaskOperationalEvidenceReader
python_interfaces.rule: read-only accepted operational evidence; Inventory/reporting may consume but cannot mutate Task lifecycle through this interface

consumed_existing_interfaces: LLD-03 RfcRepository, RfcLifecycleRepository, RfcHierarchyRepository, SrRfcRelationshipRepository, DeviceReferenceRepository
LLD-04 immutable source evidence/proposal authority through the exact WfmImportReader/WfmImportMutationService handoff
LLD-07 InventoryTaskDependencyProvider with exact matching method signatures
cross_domain_transaction_rule: LLD-04 import, LLD-03 RFC-terminal and LLD-07 retry/dependency participant writes use the caller UnitOfWork and its single command receipt. LLD-05 may add owned audit/result rows but never commits, rolls back or inserts a receipt. RFC-terminal revalidation is read-only in that UoW and precedes deliberate-proof consumption/apply; terminal apply receives explicit outer command provenance only after the outer receipt exists. RFC hard-delete classification is read-only and accepts either the preview ReadSnapshot or current writer read context without opening a nested UnitOfWork.
reader_contract: Authoritative revision, membership, overlap, lock, execution and delete decisions re-read through the supplied current reader context. Expensive previews use stable snapshots outside the writer transaction and are bound by exact fingerprints/revisions for commit-time revalidation.
